evals.prompt: I need to implement a ProductCard component from this Figma URL: https://www.figma.com/design/abc123/DS?node-id=1234-5678. Walk me through how to use Figma MCP to extract all the properties I need to implement it correctly in Flutter.
evals.expected_output: Shows complete MCP workflow: get_design_context first for guided changes, get_screenshot for each change, get_node for full tree, extraction of layout/visual/text properties, overflow risk identification, and token mapping.

assertions.text: Response calls get_design_context before any code-oriented analysis to capture guided changes and development annotations
Response parses the fileKey and nodeId from the Figma URL (decoding 1234-5678 to 1234:5678)
Response extracts literal visible text from TEXT nodes and preserves it exactly — no rewriting
Response documents layout constraints and identifies overflow risks from horizontal containers

evals.prompt: I'm using Figma MCP to analyze a button component set. It has 3 properties: Type (primary/secondary/ghost), Size (sm/md/lg), and State (default/loading/disabled). How do I extract and map these to Flutter enums?
evals.expected_output: Uses get_node on the componentSetId to get all variants, extracts variant properties, maps each to Flutter enums. Shows mapping table.

assertions.text: Response uses get_node or get_components to retrieve the component set with all variants
Response maps each Figma variant property to a Flutter enum
Response extracts visual differences between variants from the node data

evals.prompt: The Figma MCP is unavailable right now — `get_design_context` is not returning data. How should I handle this and document the limitation?
evals.expected_output: Marks as blocked_input for get_design_context. Returns control to orchestrator. Does NOT proceed without design annotations when they could affect behavior. Documents MCP status as blocked.

assertions.text: Response marks get_design_context unavailability as a blocked_input that needs to be reported
Response does NOT silently proceed without development annotations when they could affect implementation
Response documents MCP status clearly as blocked/unavailable
